title: Progressive Web Apps
definition: PWAs are web applications that use modern web APIs (like Service Workers and Web App Manifests) to provide an installable, app-like experience (offline capabilities, push notifications) on desktop and mobile devices.
simpleExplanation: A website that you can 'Install' to your phone's home screen, and it works perfectly even when you're on airplane mode.
